defects.description: The coverage failure reason names an interrupted delete whenever deletedIds has the id, so an evidence.json edited to re-add a capture the chain legitimately deleted gets a benign explanation from the only check that catches it
The clean-bill sentence renders whenever findings is empty, so with zero cases scanned or cases listed as unscanned it still says every deleted capture is gone from the database
readManifestSnapshot returns an empty buffer for a missing manifest.jsonl and an empty chain verifies, so a case whose manifest was lost counts as a verified, clean case
